epic.name: Bluprint CRM: no users in Manage Users, and students get a registration error
epic.description:
Service request from Rachell (A New Day Coaching), 2026-11-24. Manage Users shows "No users found" (screenshot 2026-10-05), and students trying to sign up get "Registration Error: Email already in use" (screenshot 2026-09-14). She wants to see her students, set goals, link their LMS and have them use the assignment tracker.

Findings

  • The empty roster was the one-bad-doc bug fixed on 2026-10-29 (a551f29). glados serves that build, and Firestore has 18 profiles (2 Coach, 11 Student, 4 Parent, 1 Developer).
  • The registration error came from one student who had already signed in with Google using that email, so the email/password sign-up was correctly refused. Neither of his Google sign-ins got a profile, because of the old sync-code backend call (also fixed on 10-29).
  • 3 Auth accounts have no users/ profile: the student's two Google logins (Sep 5 and 6) and an unknown email/password sign-up on Nov 22. The current registration code passes against the emulator under both the live and repo rules, so the Nov 22 failure was in that browser or network.
  • The firestore-rules.yml deploy has failed since 10-29 with a 403 from firebaserules.googleapis.com. The CI service account needs a rules role, so production still runs the Sep 11 rules.
  • Not a real outage: Joe's home LAN blocks anewdaycoaching.com through a safebrowse.io filter. The origin on glados is fine.

To do

  • Backfill profiles for the 3 orphaned Auth accounts (the student's two as Student).
  • Give the CI service account the Firebase Rules role and re-run the rules deploy.
  • Reply to Rachell: the roster works now, and the student should sign in with the Google button.

Decided against a server-side safety net that creates stub profiles: no profile is better than one that can't be edited.
